constraints: pane identity is not agent authority
minimal bootstrap references full context after launch
short-lived attach credential outside URL logs
reconnect revalidates session generation and workspace fence
raw terminal output is not canonical domain truth

kernel_boundary: The controller stores only runtime-neutral attach identity, fence, lifecycle events, and effect intent/receipt.
No tmux socket, pane ID, PTY object, WebSocket, browser, process, or terminal buffer enters controller domain state.
Attach input cannot invoke controller commands; it is adapter-scoped terminal input under separate authority.
parity: Both adapters enforce identical agent/run/attempt/workspace identity and current fence.
Observe mode never permits input; interactive mode requires send_input permission.
Reconnect never reuses a stale generation, expired authority, or replaced workspace fence.
Detach ends attachment, not the underlying attempt, unless a separate controller command authorizes cancellation.
